notes: Several jobs at once, and quieter updates. In Submit, COMSOL now has "One model / Several models": add several .mph files, give every model the same CPUs, RAM and time (or change a row to give one model its own), check each job's run folder and job name, and send them all with one button; they go one after another with a single COMSOL check, and a job that cannot be sent stays in a list with the reason. "Add to list" on the last step keeps any job (any software) to send later together with others. The Jobs page now shows the job you sent last on top, and Cluster > Queue opens on the busiest partition when you have nothing waiting. From this version on, updates download in the background with a thin green bar in the status bar and are installed when you close the app (or right away with "Restart now"), without interrupting you. Not code-signed yet.
